spans.s: कथक [kathaka], a. [कथ्-ण्वुल्] A narrator, a relator.
कः A chief actor, speaker of a prologue.
कथन [kathana], a. Telling, talkative. -नम् Narration, relation, description.
To be said or told or declared.
Worthy of relation, to be named.
How, in what way, in what manner, whence; कथं मारात्मके त्वयि विश्वासः
'well, how did the physician fare'; सानुबन्धाः कथं न स्युः संपदो मे निरापदः
; कथमात्मानं निवेदयामि कथं वा$$त्मापहारं करोमि Ś.1 (where the speaker is doubtful as to the propriety of what he says).
Oh what indeed ! (expressing surprise); कथं मामेवोद्दिशति Ś.6.
It is often connected with the particles इव, नाम, नु, वा, or स्वित् in the sense of, 'how indeed', 'how possibly', 'I should like to know', (where the question is generalized); कथं वा गम्यते
When connected with the particles चित्, चन or अपि it means 'in every way', 'on any account', 'somehow', 'with great difficulty', 'with great efforts'; तस्य स्थित्वा कथमपि पुरः
; कथमप्युन्नमितं न चुम्बितं तु Ś.3.24; न लोकवृत्तं वर्तेत वृत्तिहेतोः कथंचन
. -Comp. -कथिकः an inquisitive person. -कारम् ind. in what manner, how; कथंकारमनालम्बा कीर्तिर्द्यामधिरोहति Śi.2.52; कथंकारं भुङ्क्ते Sk;
. सो$हंकारं कथंकारं न करिष्यति मय्यरौ Śiva.
. -प्रमाण a. of what measure. -भावः what state. -भूत a.
of what nature or kind (oft. used by commentators). -रूप a. of what shape.-वीर्य a. of what power;
कथा [kathā], [कथ् नि˚ अ] A tale, story; ˚प्रावीण्यम्
A fable, feigned story; कथाच्छलेन बालानां नीतिस्तदिह कथ्यते H.
An account, allusion, mention; कथापि खलु पापानामलमश्रेयसे यतः Śi.2. 4.
Talk, conversation, speech; प्रथमं कृतां कथाम् Ś. 4.1.
A variety of prose composition, often distinguished from आख्यायिका; (प्रबन्धकल्पनां स्तोकसत्यां प्राज्ञाः कथां विदुः । परंपराश्रया या स्यात् सा मताख्यायिका बुधैः ॥); see under आख्यायिका also.

(In phil.) Disputation. का कथा or कथा with प्रति (what mention) is often used in the sense of 'what need one say of', 'not to mention', 'to say nothing of', 'how much more', or 'how much less'; का कथा बाणसंधाने ज्याशब्देनैव दूरतः । हुंकारेणेव धनुषः स हि विघ्नानपोहति Ś.3.1; अभितप्तमयो$पि मार्दवं भजते कैव कथा शरीरिषु
; आप्तवागनुमानाभ्भ्यां साध्यं त्वां प्रति का कथा 1.28;

another tale. -अवशेष or कथाशेष a. one of whom only the narrative remains, i. e. deceased, dead. -आक्रमः the commencement of a conversation. -आरम्भः commencement of a tale. -आरामः garden of fable. -आलापः speech, conversation. -उदयः the beginning of a tale.
उद्धातः the second of the five kinds of प्रस्तावना, where the first character enters the stage after overhearing and repeating either the words of the manager (सूत्रधार) or their sense; see S.
; e. g. in Ratn., Ve. or Mudrārākṣasa.
commencement of a tale or narration; आकुमारकथोद्धातं शालिगोप्यो जगुर्यशः
छलम् the guise of a fable.
giving a false account. -नायकः, -पुरुषः the hero or leading character of a story; रामायण˚

N. of the first लम्बक or book of the कथासरित्सागर. -प्रबन्धः a tale, fiction, fable. -प्रसङ्ग a.

a curer of poisons (विषवैद्य); कथाप्रसङ्गो वार्तायां विषवैद्ये$पि वाच्यवत् Viśvakoṣa. कथाप्रसंगेन जनैरुदाहृताम्

a professional story-teller.-मात्र a. One of whom nothing but the narrative is left; deceased, dead. कालेन ते कृताः सर्वे कथामात्राः कथासु च

कथानकम् [kathānakam], A small tale; e. g. Vetālapañchaviṁśati.
कथापयति [kathāpayati], Den. P. To tell, relate &c.
काथिकः [kāthikḥ], [कथायां साधुः, कथा-ठक्] A narrator of stories; also a writer of stories.
Told, described, narrated; प्रत्येकं कथिता ह्येताः
Expressed. -तः The supreme being.-तम् A conversation, discourse; पूर्ववृत्तकथितैः पुराविदः
. -Comp. -पदम् -पदता tautology, repetition, considered as a fault of composition relating to a sentence, where a word is used without any specific purpose; see K.
To cause to remain only in narration.
कथीकृत [kathīkṛta], a. Remaining in narration (only), dead, deceased; अवगम्य कथीकृतं वपुः
To tell, relate, narrate, communicate (usually with dat. of person); राममिष्वसनदर्शनोत्सुकं मैथिलाय कथयांबभूव सः
To declare, state, mention; अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति ते$व्ययाम्
To converse, talk with, hold conversation with; कथयित्वा सुमन्त्रेण सह Rām.
To describe, relate; किं कथ्यते श्रीरुभयस्य तस्य
To inform, give information about, complain against;
To praise, narrate devotedly; भुवि त्वां कथयन्तो हि सिद्धिमेष्यन्ति राघव
To be regarded or considered as.
